scheme_name: Fellowship Scheme for M.Phil & Ph.D for Scheduled Caste Students (Maharaja Sayajirao Gayakvad Scholarship)
description:
The Fellowship Scheme for M.Phil & Ph.D for Scheduled Caste Students is a significant initiative by the Government of India aimed at promoting higher education among Scheduled Caste students.

This scheme is also known as the Maharaja Sayajirao Gayakvad Scholarship.

It was launched in the year 2006.

The primary objective of this fellowship is to provide financial assistance to Scheduled Caste students pursuing M.Phil and Ph.D. degrees.

The scheme aims to enhance the participation of Scheduled Caste students in higher education.

It seeks to ensure that these students have equal opportunities to pursue advanced studies.

The fellowship provides a monthly stipend to eligible candidates.

As of the latest updates, the monthly stipend is set at ₹25,000 for M.Phil students.

For Ph.D. students, the monthly stipend is ₹28,000.

Additionally, there is a contingency grant of ₹10,000 per annum for both M.Phil and Ph.D. students.

The total duration of the fellowship is up to two years for M.Phil and up to five years for Ph.D. students.

The scheme also covers the cost of research-related expenses.

This includes expenses for books, travel, and other necessary materials.

The eligibility criteria for this fellowship are specifically designed to support Scheduled Caste students.

Candidates must belong to the Scheduled Caste category as defined by the Government of India.

They must have completed their post-graduation with at least 55% marks from a recognized university.

For those applying for the Ph.D. fellowship, they must have cleared the NET or equivalent examination.

The age limit for applicants is typically set at 30 years for M.Phil and 35 years for Ph.D. candidates.

The application process for the fellowship is systematic and requires several steps.

Interested candidates must first visit the official website of the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment.

They must download the application form provided on the website.

The completed application form must be submitted along with necessary documents.

Required documents include proof of Scheduled Caste certificate, educational qualifications, and income certificate.

Candidates must also provide a research proposal outlining their intended area of study.

Once the application is submitted, it is reviewed by the respective university or institution.

The selection committee evaluates the applications based on merit and eligibility criteria.

Selected candidates are notified through official communication.

The fellowship amount is disbursed directly to the bank account of the beneficiaries.

Disbursement typically occurs on a quarterly basis.

The first installment is usually released after the selection process is completed.

Subsequent installments depend on the continuation of the fellowship and satisfactory academic progress.

The implementing authority for this scheme is the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment.

The National Scheduled Castes Finance and Development Corporation plays a role in the administration of the scheme.

For any queries or assistance, candidates can contact the Ministry directly.

The contact details are available on the official website of the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment.

The scheme has seen a significant increase in participation since its inception.

In the first year, approximately 1,000 students benefited from the fellowship.

By 2023, this number has increased to over 5,000 students annually.

The fellowship has contributed to a notable rise in the number of Scheduled Caste students pursuing higher education.

It has also helped in reducing the dropout rates among these students.

The government has allocated a budget of ₹50 crores for the fellowship scheme in the financial year 2023-2024.

This funding is aimed at ensuring that more students can access the benefits of the fellowship.

The scheme is part of the larger initiative by the Government of India to promote social equity.

It aligns with the constitutional mandate to uplift marginalized communities.

The fellowship also encourages research in various fields by Scheduled Caste scholars.

This initiative has led to increased representation of Scheduled Caste students in higher academic institutions.

The government regularly reviews the scheme to enhance its effectiveness.

Feedback from beneficiaries is taken into account to improve the implementation process.

The scheme is a crucial step towards achieving educational empowerment for Scheduled Caste communities.

It reflects the commitment of the Indian government towards inclusive education.

The fellowship also aims to foster a culture of research and innovation among Scheduled Caste students.

It is a vital tool in bridging the educational gap faced by these communities.

The impact of the fellowship can be seen in the growing number of Ph.D. scholars from Scheduled Caste backgrounds.

The government encourages educational institutions to promote awareness about the fellowship.

Workshops and seminars are organized to inform potential candidates about the application process.

The scheme has received positive feedback from educational institutions and beneficiaries alike.

It has been instrumental in changing the narrative around higher education for Scheduled Caste students.

The fellowship is a testament to the government's efforts in promoting social justice through education.

In conclusion, the Fellowship Scheme for M.Phil & Ph.D for Scheduled Caste Students is a comprehensive initiative.

It provides financial support and encourages higher education among marginalized communities.

The scheme is designed to empower students and promote equality in educational opportunities.

It is a significant step towards achieving a more inclusive society through education.
